title: Crushridge
wikitext:
The Crushridge are a clan of [[ogres]] that have taken up residence in the ruins of [[Alterac]]. Their leader, [[Mug'thol]], was able to free himself of [[Sylvanas Windrunner]]'s control using the [[Crown of Will]] and he broke away from the [[Forsaken]], renamed his clan the Crushridge and established a new home in Crushridge Hold.

The Crushridge Clan currently controls the fallen human city of [[Alterac]]. The [[Syndicate]], being the remnants of [[Alterac]]'s citizenry, are in a constant battle with the Crushridge ogres for supremacy of the region.
